cidr_block.description: CIDR block notation (e.g. 10.0.0.0/24). If provided, start_ip and end_ip are ignored.

cidr_output.description: If true, uses the -c flag to print the smallest CIDR block containing the range.

delimiter.description: Custom delimiter character (ASCII code or character). Empty string means default newline.

end_ip.description: Ending IPv4 address of the range.

exclude_ranges.description: List of IP ranges to exclude from output. Each item can be an IP or a range (e.g. 10.0.0.1 or 10.0.0.1-10.0.0.5). Uses -e flag.

format.description: Output format for IP addresses: dot, hex, or dec. Uses -f flag.

increment.description: Increment step for IP addresses. Uses -i flag.

start_ip.description: Starting IPv4 address of the range.
